steps.do: Sit in the home base on preset 1 and look around.
steps.look_for: A room, not the dark; every station visible and reachable from the seat without turning your body; brightness comfortable.

steps.do: Craft, fit and launch from the stations by pointing.
steps.look_for: The aim ray points where the hand points; each station is read at a glance.

steps.do: Spend two minutes reading every station from the seat.
steps.look_for: No strain; the station in use comes forward comfortably on presets 1 to 3; the note under the selected row stands apart.

steps.do: Open the Workbench and read a recipe.
steps.look_for: Cost, held count and effect readable with no ids.

steps.do: Mount a gun in Primary 1, then look at Primary 2.
steps.look_for: Primary 2 offers it as "Move here"; Crew Quarters shows one row per role.

steps.do: Tap the menu and scroll inside Comfort.
steps.look_for: A short list read at a glance; scrolling is easy to follow; #31 reads as a seed.

steps.do: Show the controller labels in a resting grip and with hands close.
steps.look_for: Every label reads; none overlaps or sits inside a controller; text size comfortable.

steps.do: Hold up the map on preset 1, then try the cockpit place and both turns.
steps.look_for: Readable at 27° right, 10° down, 40 cm; note whether turning with the ship or fixed should be the default.

steps.do: Fly seed #31 and look at the walls under the headlight.
steps.look_for: Worn rock and metal, not flat grey; nothing shimmers at a distance; openings and edges look solid.

steps.do: Look around the cockpit on each preset.
steps.look_for: Metal and glass under the headlight; nothing moves with the view; seams calm in peripheral vision on presets 1 and 2.

steps.do: Meet each robot type at a distance and up close.
steps.look_for: Each type known by its lights far off and its shape near; thrusters brighten with speed.

steps.do: Fire each gun at walls and robots, and kill one close.
steps.look_for: Each shot known half-way with eyes closed; wall, robot and ship hits differ; a close blast never fills the view.

steps.do: Find dropped guns, components and a trapped miner in a dark tunnel.
steps.look_for: Guns told apart at 5 to 15 m; component kinds told apart without reading; the miner reads as someone to rescue.

steps.do: Pick something up and rescue a miner.
steps.look_for: Both noticed without looking for them; the count on the panel reads at a glance on preset 1.

steps.do: On preset 1, fly near fire and a cave-in.
steps.look_for: They feel urgent; blue flames do not read as the reactor; dust never hides the tunnel.

steps.do: Reach the reactor, blow it and look at the wreck.
steps.look_for: The heart of the mine, then a disaster; flames fade, never flash; comfortable on preset 1.

steps.do: Turn fast at a junction and fly through doors.
steps.look_for: Nothing pops in or flickers at an opening; smooth in a large room cluster.

steps.do: Escape a level and look at the shaft choice.
steps.look_for: The three shafts compared on robots, alarm and finds without reading; pointing highlights a shaft at every preset.

steps.do: Look at the ship on its cradle and in the ship_model screenshots.
steps.look_for: It reads as a ship; say if 2.5 m nose to tail looks too big.

steps.do: Fire, get hit and kill a robot, turning your head.
steps.look_for: Each has its own sound from the right direction.

steps.do: Fly from a narrow tunnel into a big room and fire.
steps.look_for: The echo opens up over about a second, no jump.

steps.do: Play a run to the reactor and an end screen, then the base.
steps.look_for: Calm in flight, urgent within a second of the reactor blowing, fades on the end screens, hub track at the base; never drowns a robot.

steps.do: Fight steadily for half a minute.
steps.look_for: Tension layers fade in; the alarm chime is not too loud; a level flown alone stays calm.

steps.do: Listen with eyes closed and round corners.
steps.look_for: A drone told from a hauler or warden; a robot heard before it appears; dull behind a wall, open in the same room.

steps.do: Suspend at a shaft choice, quit the game completely, start it and resume.
steps.look_for: The same guns and hull as when suspended.

steps.do: In a run, choose Return to base from the menu.
steps.look_for: It counts as a lost ship.

steps.do: Run the device suites m1, m3, m4 and m6 from the PC.
steps.look_for: Each passes; the report is posted to the gate issue.

steps.do: Play for a while as a player would.
steps.look_for: It looks, sounds and runs well enough to keep playing.

steps.do: A VR-sensitive tester flies 10 minutes on preset 1.
steps.look_for: They finish without discomfort.
